connector.name: Swissgroceries MCP
connector.registryDescription: Swiss grocery search, promotions, and shopping plans across Migros, Coop, Aldi, Denner, Lidl.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package swissgroceries-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nicktcode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DENNER_JWT
env.description: Optional pre-supplied Denner Bearer JWT. Without it, the adapter self-registers anonymously on first use and rotates the token automatically.

env.name: LIDL_DEFAULT_STORE
env.description: Default Lidl store ID used when no storeIds are passed. Defaults to CH0149.

env.name: SWISSGROCERIES_USER_AGENT_COOP
env.description: Override the User-Agent string for Coop calls if DataDome ever blocks the default.

env.name: SWISSGROCERIES_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging verbosity: silent, info (default), or debug.

env.name: SWISSGROCERIES_DISABLE_CACHE
env.description: Set to 1 to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache.
